claim: A machine-timing change (NextReg $03) is taken by the video counters at once, not at the frame end: the frame being drawn runs on to the new length, then one short frame follows.
limit: One board and core (KS1 Issue 2, 3.03.00), 128K to Pentagon timing at line 100. The book says the change waits for the frame end.

evidence.text: KS1 Issue 2, core 3.03.00 (nxsuite XT2): $03 written at line 100 of a 311-line frame (128K to Pentagon): that frame ran to 320 lines, then a 7-line frame, then 320-line frames.
